A hierarchy chart showing types of securities. At the top: "Securities". Two branches: "Ownership (Equity)" and "Debt (Loans)". Under Ownership: "Shares" (branching to Ordinary and Preference) and "Stocks". Under Debt: "Bonds (Gilt-edged)" and "Debentures". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

An illustration showing the three types of stock market speculators. On the left, a muscular Bull charging upwards, with a green arrow pointing up (representing rising prices). In the middle, a large Bear swiping its paw downwards, with a red arrow pointing down (representing falling prices). On the right, a Stag (male deer with antlers) holding a sheet of paper with a quick cash symbol next to it.
